scope: Correlation of cached aligned bytes, not organizer authentication or a fault-score experiment

training_band_tags.description: Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection

radiometric_quantization: uint8 1..255 over per-channel 1st..99th pct after area mosaic; 0=nodata
cached_report_quote: 22103_tc.grd:  Total Count Grid in Geosoft Grid Format
sample_policy: uniform without replacement from joint finite template, band-6 and all four nonzero u8 channels
interpretation: Band 6 is almost monotonically related to the cached u8 total-count product. This is strong evidence consistent with radiometric total count, not proof of the band source, units or the independent authenticity of either cache. The mirror tag instead says magnetic tilt/curvature; a positive numeric range cannot establish Bouguer terrain correction. The historic feature alias is preserved for reproducibility, not asserted as physical truth.
